long: Deletes catalog records without regard to retention periods. It needs full access to every resource.

purge volume all (Onesimus extension) purges every volume of one pool (pool=) or of all pools the console may access (allpools) whose status is one of volstatus= (default Full,Used,Error). It is never interactive: dryrun only shows what would be purged, yes purges.

long: Prints the grammar of every command the console may run (CommandACL): subcommand words, keywords, key=value arguments, value sources, repeatable keys and exclusive groups. In API mode 2 the reply is the JSON object "grammar" (schema 1), otherwise one usage line per command and subcommand.
